week.headline: The NFELO model and Vegas are 14.0 percentage points apart on Arizona at Kansas City.

rest.headline: Buffalo projects to 13.8 wins, the most in the league.
rest.note: Projected wins = wins so far + half a win per tie + the sum of the team's win probabilities in its remaining games.

playoff_odds.headline: Cleveland's playoff chances rose the most this week, to 60%. Buffalo is the Super Bowl favorite at 15%.
